claude.rationale: The acquired business was fully absorbed into PacWest, which reported as one consolidated segment throughout FY2020-FY2021 and never names "CU Bancorp" or "California United Bank" in its filings, so no distinct product/process trajectory is separately observable to assess p4. Likewise, the slice documents no operations-vs-organization fracture — only that the acquired entity ceased separate reporting and its results are undifferentiated within the acquirer's consolidated figures — leaving p5 indeterminable. Because the outcome for the acquired business is explicitly stated to be not publicly observable within the window, disruption at these interfaces can neither be confirmed nor ruled out.
